title: Paper call: The Federal Bank Ltd 5-year outcome ≥3.0x from 2026-11-20 (decision card v1)
body: Forward test of the decision-card method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell; PRACTICE EXAMPLE built from test inputs). Probability 0.03 (base rate 0.444, class india_survivors_2020_25_mcap_ge400) that: YES if the total-return multiple (adjusted close incl. dividends reinvested, splits/bonuses adjusted) from 2026-11-20 (entry INR 373.50) to the last close on or before 2031-11-20 is ≥ 3.0. Model: worksheet scenarios bear 35%→0.95x, base 45%→1.41x, bull 18%→2.17x with σ=0.30; reverse DCF base-case IRR 10.0%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Stage 4 soft flags (11 open, no variant view → NO POSITION); Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.36x vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Score with Brier vs the base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: India, random NSE sample, mcap >= Rs 400 cr at T0, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2020. Survivors only (firms delisted before mid-2023 absent -> loss rates understated); T0 was six months after the Mar-2020 low and 2020-25 was a strong small/mid-cap bull market (-> x3 overstated). One snapshot. Treat as an upper bound for P(>=3x) and a lower bound for P(<=0.5x).
data.resolution_rule: YES if the total-return multiple (adjusted close incl. dividends reinvested, splits/bonuses adjusted) from 2026-11-20 (entry INR 373.50) to the last close on or before 2031-11-20 is ≥ 3.0.
data.resolution_source: NSE/BSE or exchange adjusted closes (Yahoo adj close / Kite), corporate actions
